schema_version: v0 — migrates when Q6 (intention envelope) lands
owner: akiendelllinux_cc_0 (CC) — CC gates writes. Name descriptive (it interprets the diagnostic breadcrumbs); the CLI face would be `cairn diagnose <pointer>`.
intention: THE DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETER: given a pointer (a ticket id / address), crawl the emission breadcrumbs (cairn/base/diagnostic.py emits — thin, microsecond-stamped, home to CC's mailbox) and the timestamp-indexed logs, gather the WHOLE transaction (the workflow item AND its logging), and trim it into a coherent slice — the complete first-pass report a resolver needs, with no second run. PLUS the LEARNING-LOOP: when a report proves insufficient (a gap forced a second run to resolve some additional point), record that miss against the transition-class and FOLD it into what the next report for that class must carry — so the same gap never costs a second run again. The emission stays dumb (Law 6, only the pointer crosses); the interpreter is where the intelligence AND the learning live (Law 1 — the diagnostic surface's inference compiled once, the inference_domain move).
why: Instantiates [[I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass]] — the report resolves it on the first pass, a method Akien has PROVEN over decades (2007 framework, UU, Trouble Tickets; half-day→10min; his first-reach debugging tool). Proven infra, built AHEAD of need, not grown-against it. DiagnosticBase.emit (built) is the dumb breadcrumb; this is the smart reader its own docstring named as 'the next build'. The learning-loop makes the report SELF-TEACHING: it is [[I-learns-its-gates]] pointed at the diagnostic surface — the report learns its own completeness from the evidence of what it missed, so completeness rises monotonically and no learned gap recurs.
traces_to: [[I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass]] (the concept-piece this instantiates — the report delivers all resolve-data on the first pass)
Law 7 SHARPENED (the diagnostic surface is not merely loud but COMPLETE on first emission)
Law 1 (re-running to gather more failure data is re-deriving the settled — the waste the complete report kills; and the interpreter's inference is compiled ONCE, the inference_domain move)
[[I-learns-its-gates]] (the learning-loop is gate-learning pointed at the diagnostic surface — a distinct endpoint: it learns what a report must CARRY, not whether CC may act)
Law 6 (the emission stays a thin pointer; owned data stays with its owner — the interpreter reads, it does not copy the ticket)

gates: proof gate (tester) — a proof a hollow interpreter could not pass: (1) THE REPORT — given a set of emission breadcrumbs for a known pointer (across gates, microsecond-ordered), assert the interpreter gathers exactly that transaction (nothing from other pointers bleeds in), orders it by the 6th-decimal stamp, and trims it into a coherent slice carrying every emitted value — a resolver reading only the slice has what it needs. (2) THE LEARNING-LOOP — mark a report insufficient for a transition-class with a named missing datum; assert the NEXT report for that class demands/surfaces that datum (the first miss folded in, Law 1); and assert that if the SAME already-learned gap recurs, the interpreter flags it LOUD as the terminal-falsifier condition (the surface failed to consume its evidence). VALIDATION persisted beside-code via cairn/tester/validation_store.persist_validation. Durability gate: proven + committed (git).
falsifier: the interpreter assembles a complete, coherent first-pass report from the breadcrumbs+logs for a pointer, and its learning-loop folds each forced-second-run's miss into the next report's completeness. Wrong-shape signals: (1) the report is INCOMPLETE by construction — it drops emitted values or bleeds in other pointers' records (not a faithful slice); (2) the learning-loop does not actually change the next report (records the miss but never folds it — learning theater); (3) an already-learned gap recurs and the loop stays SILENT (the terminal falsifier of the principle — Law 1 defect, re-deriving the settled — must be loud, Law 7); (4) the interpreter grows to EMIT (it becomes a second emitter, collapsing the dumb-breadcrumb / smart-reader split — Law 6); (5) the learned-completeness store is merged INTO the decision-autonomy gate-store (two distinct learnings collapsed — the distinction this ticket recorded).
